nate: Quick thread 1: mobile breakpoints for the Rollouts list. On narrow screens the variant chips collapse into a single "Variants" pill that opens a sheet. Product wants to keep the list dense but still make rollback obvious. Thoughts? https://figma.com/file/abcd (mobile frames) claire: For mobile, I think we should surface the active traffic percent and a tiny rollback affordance inline (icon-only) so power users can act without opening detail sheets. But we need to avoid accidental taps. Maybe require a long-press to surface the full rollback CTA? dmitri: Long-press patterns are inconsistent across Android OEMs and iOS. Alternate: show an icon with a 2-step tap: tap icon -> confirm inline CTA appears -> tap Confirm. That keeps tap targets small but explicit. eva: Accessibility + copy notes: the icon needs an accessible label like "Open variant actions" and the confirm step should include context: "Rollback variant X (will redirect 100% of traffic)". For SR: avoid "rollback" as the primary verb in the list; use "Revert to" in modals since it's clearer. nate: Good call on copy. Also colorblindness: current red/green for canary pass/fail won't work. Suggest we use color + pattern/icon (e.g., outline for inactive, filled badge for active) and a semantic label (Live / Preview). claire: On density: when collapsed into the sheet, we can show small sparklines for recent latency/regressions. But sparklines are noisy at 320px width; better to show a 1px mini-bar or a trend chevron with label (e.g., +12% latency). dmitri: Implementation constraints: the list is virtualized. Expanding a sheet per row needs to avoid reflow. Suggest we pre-allocate an offscreen panel and populate it on demand rather than inserting DOM nodes per expand. Also keep animations off by default for reduced-motion. eva: Keyboard & screen reader flow: ensure the variant pill is reachable by keyboard and opens the sheet with `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and focus moved into the sheet. Use `aria-describedby` to link the variant actions to the traffic implication text. Example: ```

Revert to blue-variant will route 100% traffic to version 2.3

``` claire: UX detail: micro-confirmation toast after rollback should include an "Undo" action and persist for 8s. Use neutral tone: "Reverted to blue-variant. Undo". Avoid alarmist language. nate: Small-screen affordance debate: show inline rollback icon or require opening sheet? Product leans inline for speed, but Eng wants to reduce accidental triggers. Proposal: inline icon visible but low-contrast until tapped (ghost icon). First tap brightens icon and reveals Confirm, second tap executes. That matches the 2-step flow dmitri suggested. eva: SR copy tweak: primary Confirm button inside sheet: "Revert to this variant". Danger-styled color only in the modal confirmation, not on passive list items. Also add `role="status"` aria region to announce when revert completes. dmitri: I'll prototype the 2-tap inline flow and a11y hooks. Will also add `prefers-reduced-motion` handling and ensure virtualized list doesn't lose focus when sheet opens. aria-bot: Accessibility scan results: keyboard focus order initial pass OK, missing `aria-describedby` on variant icons flagged, color-contrast on ghost icon borderline in dark mode. Actions: bump contrast, add aria-describedby. nate: Thanks! @claire @dmitri can you drop the small mobile gif + notes back here by EOD? I'll update the figma with the revised copy and the chevron trend indicator. Cheers :v:
